# AI tools and operations

<!-- Generated by test/widget_ai_coverage_test.dart from lib/app/ai/ai_coverage.dart and the tool, operation and setting descriptions. Do not edit by hand: UPDATE_AI_TOOLS_DOC=1 flutter test test/widget_ai_coverage_test.dart -->

How the AI assistant of OpenCADIrrigation reaches every function of the program. The model works with:

- **tools** sent with every request (`tool:`): reading the project, creating and changing items, the design, the automatic layouts, the view, the site;
- **operations** (`op:`) that are not sent, so the requests stay small: the model looks them up with `find_operations` and runs them with `run_operation`, which takes the effect, confirmation and approval line of the operation it runs;
- **commands** (`command:`): `run_command` runs any alias of the command line or action by name; a command that opens a dialog runs the operation behind it headless (reads answer what the dialog would show; changes wait for their input), drawing tools that take the user's clicks are answered with what to call instead;
- **settings** (`setting:`): `get_setting` / `set_setting` over the design parameters, units, project details, quote, view, snapping, tool defaults and program options, typed and range-checked;
- `n/a`: functions with no meaning for the AI, with the reason.

Permissions: reads run freely; changes are undo steps and follow the user's mode (asked in "ask", refused in read-only and plan); exports and large deletions are confirmed by the user even when changes apply automatically; network requests (site search, terrain and climate downloads) are asked in "ask" and run freely when changes apply automatically. View, snapping, tool and program settings are not changes of the project.

## Settings (get_setting / set_setting)

| Key | Type | Scope | What it sets |
|---|---|---|---|
| `params.frictionMethod` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): hazenWilliams (one of hazenWilliams, darcyWeisbach, scobey, manning) — pipe friction formula: hazenWilliams (each pipe's C), darcyWeisbach (roughness, viscosity from waterTempC), scobey or manning |
| `params.waterTempC` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 20.0 °C (0 … 60) — water viscosity, and the derating of PVC and PE pressure classes in warm water |
| `params.maxLateralVelocity` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 2.0 m/s (0.3 … 5) — limit in laterals: the sizing respects it, faster segments are flagged (velocity_exceeded) |
| `params.maxZoneVelocity` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 1.5 m/s (0.3 … 5) — limit in zone pipes (submains, manifolds) |
| `params.maxMainlineVelocity` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 2.0 m/s (0.3 … 5) — limit in mainline pipes |
| `params.applyMinorLosses` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): true (true/false) — add local losses (minorLossMethod) to the friction |
| `params.minorLossMethod` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): percent (one of percent, fittings) — percent: minorLossPct of each pipe's length as equivalent length; fittings: the K of the bends (from 22.5°) and tees the drawing implies |
| `params.minorLossPct` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 5.0 % of length (0 … 100) — with minorLossMethod percent |
| `params.hazenCScale` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 1.0 (0.3 … 1.5) — calibration: every Hazen-Williams C is multiplied by it (below 1 for aged pipes) |
| `params.hazenCOffset` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 0.0 (-50 … 50) — calibration: added to every C after the scale |
| `params.sizingMethod` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): lp (one of lp, greedy) — lp: least annual cost (pipe annuity, plus energy when tradeCapitalVsRunning) within the pressure windows and velocity limits; greedy: velocity, then the pressure window, then cost |
| `params.maxLateralSizes` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 1 sizes (1 … 3) — diameters along one lateral (telescoping) |
| `params.maxSubmainSizes` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 3 sizes (1 … 5) — diameters along one zone pipe |
| `params.maxMainlineSizes` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 3 sizes (1 … 5) — diameters along one mainline pipe |
| `params.maxZoneVariationPct` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 0.0 % (0 … 60) — above 0 it narrows every zone's pressure window to its mean nominal pressure ± half this (20 → ±10 %); 0 = the emitters' own windows |
| `params.emittersPerPlant` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 1 (1 … 20) — emitters per plant in the Keller-Karmeli emission uniformity (an area's epp overrides it) |
| `params.maxNodesPerLateral` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 100 nodes (2 … 500) — the emitters of a lateral are lumped into at most this many nodes (accuracy against speed) |
| `params.connectTolerance` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 0.05 m (0.001 … 1) — points closer than this are one node of the network; the connect correction reaches 20 times as far (at least 2 m) |
| `params.terrainDensify` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 5.0 m (0 … 100) — spacing of the points taken along contours for the terrain model |
| `params.terrainMethod` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): tin (one of tin, idw) — tin: triangulation of the terrain data, exact on planes; idw: inverse-distance weighting, smooth and defined outside the data too |
| `params.flushingVelocity` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 0.3 m/s (0 … 3) — velocity at the open end of the tapes in the flushing analysis |
| `params.flushingMinEndHeadM` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 1.0 m (0 … 50) — least pressure kept at the open end while flushing |
| `params.checkSurge` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): true (true/false) — Joukowsky surge check of every pipe's pressure class (surge table) |
| `params.valveClosureTimeS` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 0.0 s (0 … 600) — closure time for the surge check; 0 = instantaneous (the worst case); solenoid valves close in about 3 s |
| `params.selectFittings` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): true (true/false) — pick the fittings (tees, elbows, reducers, couplers) for the bill of materials |
| `params.pipeStickLengthM` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 6.0 m (0 … 20) — pipe length per stick for counting couplers; 0 = no couplers per stick |
| `params.solenoidInrushA` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 0.37 A (0.01 … 5) — valve solenoid current while it opens (wiring check) |
| `params.solenoidHoldingA` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 0.22 A (0 … 5) — valve solenoid current once open |
| `params.solenoidMinVolts` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 20.0 V (1 … 48) — least voltage that opens a solenoid; the wiring check compares each valve's voltage with it (elec_voltage) |
| `params.wireSlackPct` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 10.0 % (0 … 50) — wire added to the routes for splices and loops |
| `params.tradeCapitalVsRunning` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): true (true/false) — the sizing weighs energy against pipe cost; false = the cheapest pipes that meet the limits |
| `params.interestRate` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 0.1 fraction/year (0 … 0.5) — capital recovery: costs annualised over termYears at this rate |
| `params.termYears` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 10 years (1 … 100) — economic life for the annual capital cost |
| `params.powerCostPerKwh` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 0.1458735 currency/kWh (0 … 100) — energy tariff, in the project currency |
| `params.pumpEfficiency` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 0.65 fraction (0.2 … 0.95) — efficiency for the energy of a calculated supply (pumps use their own curve) |
| `params.hoursPerYear` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 2000.0 h/year (1 … 8760) — mainline and pump operating hours, shared among the system flows by their durations |
| `params.zoneHoursPerYear` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 500.0 h/year (1 … 8760) — hours each zone runs a year: the weight of its inlet pressure in the zone sizing |
| `params.mainsHz` | design parameter | project | Design parameter (set_parameters): 60.0 Hz (50 … 60) — mains frequency: fixed-speed pumps rated at another frequency turn proportionally faster or slower |
| `units.system` | one of metric, us, custom | project | Display units at once: "metric" (m, L/h, m of water, mm) or "us" (ft, gpm, psi, in); "custom" when mixed. The project file stays SI. |
| `units.length` | one of m, mm, cm, ft, inch | project | Display unit of lengths in reports and fields. |
| `units.flow` | one of lph, lpm, lps, m3h, gpm | project | Display unit of flows (lph = L/h, lpm = L/min, lps = L/s). |
| `units.pressure` | one of mH2O, kPa, bar, psi | project | Display unit of pressures (mH2O = metres of water). |
| `units.diameter` | one of mm, inch | project | Display unit of pipe diameters. |
| `project.name` | string | project | Project name (title block, file name). |
| `project.client` | string | project | Client. |
| `project.site` | string | project | Site or farm. |
| `project.designer` | string | project | Designer. |
| `project.notes` | string | project | Notes of the project. |
| `quote.markup_pct` | number -100 … 1000, % | project | Margin over the cost of the materials, applied to every bill-of-materials line. |
| `quote.labour_pct` | number 0 … 1000, % | project | Labour (installation) as a share of the material cost. |
| `quote.trench_cost_per_m3` | number 0 … 1000000000 | project | Excavation and backfill per cubic metre of trench (project currency). |
| `quote.trench_width_m` | number 0 … 10, m | project | Trench width; 0 = from the pipe (outside diameter + 0.2 m, at least 0.3 m). |
| `quote.bedding_m` | number 0 … 2, m | project | Bedding under the pipe, added to the trench depth. |
| `quote.discount_pct` | number 0 … 100, % | project | Discount over the subtotal. |
| `quote.tax_pct` | number 0 … 100, % | project | Taxes over the discounted subtotal. |
| `quote.freight` | number 0 … 1000000000 | project | Freight and delivery (project currency), outside the taxes. |
| `quote.validity_days` | integer 1 … 3650, days | project | Days the prices hold. |
| `quote.payment_terms` | string | project | Payment terms printed on the quote. |
| `quote.notes` | string | project | Notes printed on the quote. |
| `quote.annual_benefit` | number 0 … 1000000000000 | project | Yearly benefit of the system (project currency), for the payback. |
| `quote.crews` | integer 1 … 50 | project | Crews working at the same time (construction schedule). |
| `view.grid` | boolean | view | Show the background grid (View → Grid, F7). |
| `view.labels` | boolean | view | Show the result labels on the drawing (View → Labels). |
| `view.wetted_radii` | boolean | view | Show the wetted circles of sprinklers (View → Wetted radii). |
| `view.grips` | boolean | view | Show the editing grips of selected items (View → Grips). |
| `view.overlay` | one of none, velocity, pressure, sizes, minMax, densogram, slope, aspect | view | Colouring of the drawing (View → Overlay): velocity, pressure, sizes, minMax (zone pressure range), densogram (water applied), slope / aspect maps of the terrain, or none. |
| `view.base_map` | one of none, streets, topo, carto, satellite, esriStreets, esriTopo, googleRoads, googleSatellite, googleHybrid, googleTerrain, custom | view | Base map under the drawing (needs a georeference). The google* maps need the user's own Map Tiles API key (View → Base map → Google key; the assistant never handles keys), custom needs view.custom_tile_url. |
| `view.base_map_opacity` | number 0.05 … 1 | view | Opacity of the base map. |
| `view.custom_tile_url` | string | view | XYZ tile template of the custom base map, e.g. https://example.com/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png ({z}, {x}, {y}, optional {s} and {-y}); "" removes it. Kept in this browser. |
| `view.theme` | one of dark, light, system | view | Colour theme of the program (View → Theme), kept in this browser. |
| `view.language` | one of id, de, en, es, fr, ha, sw, pt, vi, tr, ru, ar, ur, hi, mr, bn, pa, te, zh, ja | view | Language of the interface (View → Language), for every open tab, kept in this browser: id Bahasa Indonesia, de Deutsch, en English, es Español, fr Français, ha Hausa, sw Kiswahili, pt Português, vi Tiếng Việt, tr Türkçe, ru Русский, ar العربية, ur اردو, hi हिन्दी, mr मराठी, bn বাংলা, pa ਪੰਜਾਬੀ, te తెలుగు, zh 中文, ja 日本語. The user's choice: change it when the user asks. Your answers follow the language the user writes in. |
| `view.reports_panel` | boolean | view | Show the reports panel under the drawing (F2). |
| `view.report_tab` | one of reports.zone, reports.pipes, reports.outlets, reports.mainline, reports.bom, reports.water, reports.hgl, reports.messages, reports.profile, reports.flushing, reports.surge, reports.crop, reports.schedule, reports.pivots, reports.pivotSpans, reports.electrical, reports.proposal, reports.trench, reports.bomZones, reports.comments, reports.revisions, reports.scenarios, reports.requirement, reports.pivotPackage, reports.machines, reports.vih | view | Tab of the reports panel (shown when the panel opens). |
| `view.active_tool` | one of select, pan, line, polyline, rect, circle, arc, spline, hatch, symbol, text, dimension, dimAngular, dimRadial, leader, contour, breakline, spot, area, zonePipe, mainPipe, sprayline, tape, outlet, valve, supply, pump, misc, junction, block, autohead, measure, rotate, mirror, scale, offset, trim, extend, cutPipe, profile, pivot, alignImage, controller, wire, dimOrdinate, comment, revisionCloud, insertBlock, aiMarkPoint, aiMarkLine | view | The user's active drawing tool (it waits for the user's clicks; the assistant draws with create_entities and the operations instead). |
| `view.visible_bbox` | array, read-only | view | Part of the drawing on screen [minX, minY, maxX, maxY] in metres (move it with zoom_to or zoom_view). |
| `view.scale` | number, px/m, read-only | view | Screen pixels per metre of the view (read-only; zoom_view changes it). |
| `snap.enabled` | boolean | view | Object snap of the drawing tools (F3). |
| `snap.grid` | boolean | view | Snap to the grid (F9). |
| `snap.grid_size_m` | number 0.001 … 10000, m | view | Grid spacing used by the grid snap. |
| `snap.ortho` | boolean | view | Orthogonal mode: segments horizontal or vertical (F8). |
| `snap.polar_step_deg` | number 0 … 90, ° | view | Polar tracking step (0 = off; the status bar cycles 0, 15, 30, 45, 90). |
| `snap.tolerance_px` | number 1 … 50, px | view | Snap and pick distance on screen. |
| `app.autosave` | boolean | app | Autosave to this browser every few seconds of work (File → Autosave). |
| `app.auto_analyze` | boolean | app | Analyse the design again a moment after every edit (Design → Auto analyse), kept in this browser. |
| `tool.point_scope` | one of zone, mainline | tool | Scope of new outlets, pumps, devices and junctions drawn by the user. |
| `tool.zone_pipe_spec` | string, or null | tool | Pipe of new zone pipes (null = sized by the design). |
| `tool.main_pipe_spec` | string, or null | tool | Pipe of new mainline pipes (null = sized by the design). |
| `tool.lateral_pipe_spec` | string, or null | tool | Pipe of new spray laterals and blocks (null = sized by the design). |

| `tool.nozzle` | string, or null | tool | Nozzle of tool.outlet_spec; also sets tool.head_m to its default head unless set in the same call. |
| `tool.head_m` | number 0.5 … 120, m | tool | Head at new emitters and spray laterals. |
| `tool.spacing_m` | number 0.05 … 100, m | tool | Emitter spacing along new spray laterals. |
| `tool.offset_m` | number 0 … 100, m | tool | Distance of the first emitter from the start of a new spray lateral (when tool.outlet_offset_half is false). |
| `tool.outlet_offset_half` | boolean | tool | First emitter of new spray laterals at half the spacing. |
| `tool.arc_deg` | number 1 … 360, ° | tool | Arc of new outlets. |
| `tool.tape_spec` | string | tool | Drip tape of new tapes; also sets tool.tape_inlet_head_m to its default inlet head unless set in the same call. |
| `tool.tape_inlet_head_m` | number 0.5 … 60, m | tool | Inlet head of new tapes. |
| `tool.valve_spec` | string | tool | Zone valve of new valves and blocks. |
| `tool.pump_spec` | string | tool | Pump of new pumps. |
| `tool.misc_spec` | string | tool | Inline device of new devices; also sets tool.misc_setting_m to its default setting unless set in the same call. |
| `tool.misc_setting_m` | number 0 … 300, m | tool | Setting of new pressure-regulating devices. |
| `tool.split_pipes_on_insert` | boolean | tool | A point item drawn on a pipe splits it there. |
| `tool.keep_connections` | boolean | tool | Dragging a pipe node drags the items joined there (status bar "keep links"). |
| `tool.contour_elevation_m` | number -1000 … 9000, m | tool | Elevation of the next contour drawn by the user. |
| `tool.contour_interval_m` | number 0.01 … 1000, m | tool | Interval added after each contour drawn (with tool.contour_auto_increment). |
| `tool.contour_auto_increment` | boolean | tool | Raise the next contour by tool.contour_interval_m. |
